content.title: About
content.content: Peanuts, chocolate covered candy are whole peanuts coated with a layer of milk or dark chocolate. The combination of crunchy nutty flavor and sweet chocolate makes it a popular confectionery treat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanuts are legumes, not true nuts.
Chocolate coating protects the peanuts from oxidation and extends shelf life.
In many countries chocolate‑covered peanuts are a traditional holiday gift.
There are many variants: milk, dark, white chocolate, and versions with sea salt, caramel or nuts.
Chocolate‑covered peanuts are often used in desserts, ice cream and baked goods.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Peanuts provide about 25 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats in peanuts promote heart health.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Provides minerals
items.content: Peanuts are a good source of magnesium, phosphorus and potassium, important for nerve and muscle function.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The mix of protein, fat and fiber helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Peanuts are one of the most common allergens and can cause severe reactions.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Chocolate adds significant calories, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sweet chocolate can raise blood sugar levels, important for people with diabetes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Chocolate‑covered peanuts are convenient as a snack, can be added to granola, yogurt, baked goods, or used as a garnish for desserts. For lower calories choose unsweetened or dark‑chocolate versions.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For long‑term storage keep refrigerated to prevent chocolate melt and fat oxidation.
